metadata.name: design-guidance-arms-magnitude-pilot
metadata.intent: Design-guidance pilot, arms magnitude profile: how pilot-grade Type I and power of the delta / angle / shape RRPP tests for the magnitude mode(s) depend on group ratio, stage proportions, differential-feature proportion, joint stage effect and baseline continuity, one at a time off the core baseline, under the production measurement (pooled PLS with the stage-supervised double-CV rank, net-displacement orientation, rank floor 2, joint magnitude). Phase 5 sensitivity deliverable (sample size, stages, blocks, signal density); 100 replicates x 199 permutations.
notes: Explicit design points (design D4), one setting moved at a time off the core baseline (n = 200, three stages, two blocks): group_ratio {0.65, 0.8}; stage_sample_prop 0.5/0.3/0.2; p_dmp {0.05, 0.15} (0.2 fails the three-stage headroom check: orientation saturates at e = 0.89 and translation at 0.52; 0.15 fits, saturating at 1.39 and 1.12); the joint stage effect delta_methyl = delta_expr = delta_protein in {0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0} (0.25-1.0 as first specified, below InterSIM's 2.0; 0.05 and 0.1 added 2026-10-28 after the ing smoke showed the held-out CV stage AUROC at 1.000 at every column except delta = 0.25 (0.988), so the arm as specified never reached the SEA-AD regime of 0.64-0.70, which the rank-floor check located near delta = 0.05-0.1); baseline_continuity {0.5, 0.8}. 13 columns, the baseline listed. An SEA-AD-style group x stage table is not repeated: the Phase 6 net-displacement power profile measured it.

Mode magnitude (joint construction) at e in {0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25}: at n = 80 with two blocks the Phase 6 study measured delta power 0.206 / 0.542 / 0.956 at 0.05 / 0.10 / 0.25, and it saturates sooner at larger n, so the axis reaches down to 0.01.

Cells and cost: 2 Type I baselines + 13 columns x (1 anchor + 1 mode(s) x 5 effects) = 80 cells, 8,000 work units at 100 replicates; planning figure 41 core-hours on ing with a 20% contention margin in 17 single-CPU shards of about 2.4 h each. Timing basis in metadata.submission.

Design-guidance pilot (change design-guidance-grid, 2026-10-28): the replacement for the project's originally planned simulation grid (Table 1). Four profiles share one baseline (n = 200, three stages, group_ratio 0.5, p_dmp 0.1, rho 0, every per-omic delta 2.0, joint magnitude; pooled PLS on methylation + expression with the Phase 6 CV knobs), one seed root (base_seed 1028) and one matched-seed family (design-guidance), at pilot grade: 100 replicates x 199 permutations.

Production measurement named, not defaulted (design-guidance spec, 'profiles name the production measurement'): orientation_estimator net_displacement, min_components 2 and magnitude_kind joint are written out so the profile states what it measures under. This is a post-floor config: it is pinned in tests/data/post_floor_config_identity.json, not in the historical pre-flip fixture, and it does not copy the historical 'pc1' / min_components 1 pins.

Magnitude and geometry are split into sibling profiles (design D1) because one effect list cannot serve both: magnitude's delta rise sits at e = 0.01-0.25 while orientation and shape leave the null only from e = 0.25. The siblings share base_seed and the seed family, so at a given design column their zero-effect anchors have different cell ids but draw the same generator seed and evaluate the same datasets (design D2). The findings report reads the geometry profile's anchor and uses the magnitude profile's anchor as a reproduction check; it never pools the two as independent replicates.

acceptance: a type_i entry and the advisory anchor_decision (alpha 0.05, k = 2, delta/angle/shape; bound 0.0936 at R = 100). No power targets, no gate, no report contract (design D8): the pilot is descriptive, proposes the slice to rerun at paper grade, and makes no floor claims.
surgery_censoring stays at its default ('error'); enumeration rejects any over-headroom cell before compute is spent. Do not pass --n-jobs; parallelize across shards.

submission.timing_basis: ing smoke 2026-10-28 (2 x 19, 880 units, 0 failures) and 16 units timed at 199 permutations: 10.7 / 13.2 / 19.4 / 27.6 s per unit at n = 80 / 200 / 500 / 1000 (3 stages, 2 blocks), 14.1 / 19.7 / 29.4 / 42.9 s (4 stages, 3 blocks); the PLS double CV dominates, the 199 RRPP permutations add 2-5 s. See openspec/changes/design-guidance-grid/notes.md.
submission.budget: ~41 core-hours with a 20% margin; ~2.4 h wall per shard
